usage.variants: Apply changes as explicit JSON Pointer replacements/upserts to a cloned base case. Do not infer changes from note. Run and report every base and every materialized variant separately.
usage.execution: Selected projections are bound to fieldRuntimeFlows.test.ts and fieldFormatContract.test.ts, with Host/Server lifecycle and HTTP controls. No complete event/model runner is bound for all cases/variants. Every case executionStatus remains not-run for full-flow acceptance; schema and boundary-control passes do not mean the complete corpus passed.
usage.stateOracle: same-as values are fixture paths; effects are observed receipts/presentation/playback requests, never model prose. Runtime adapters must map these semantic names to owning APIs.
usage.speechOracle: Verify the actual TTS scheduling/text separately from DOM rendering; this corpus does not prove physical speaker audibility.
usage.liveReplay: Manual/synthetic inputs only, explicit opt-in and frozen source/menu/model identities; do not upload private field extracts or gold expectations.
usage.providerPayload: Fault inputs may use an explicit rawBody/envelope or a normalized function/arguments projection. The owning adapter must build the real provider envelope and validate through the public boundary; never import a private validator solely to accept a fixture.
usage.effectSemantics: requiredEffects/forbiddenEffects apply only to the current step. Count assertions use the cumulative count within that isolated scenario. Domain adapters observe real accepted receipts, UI state and TTS requests.
